description: Scope parity: payload, step result, meta, caught error (error.* and vars.<captureAs>), loop item and loop index are offered, valid, and evaluate to the runtime value in Reference, Text and Expression modes; Text↔Expression round-trips (inputModeScopeParity.test.ts).

Catalog-wide Text mode coverage: every plain string input in the registered action catalog resolves to Text mode; email bodies, comment body and description are multi-line (workflowTextInputCoverage.test.ts).
Reachability: Then/Else isolation, both branches after the If, loop bodies hidden after the loop; reference options and condition fields agree (workflowDataContext.test.ts).
Condition model parses and serializes all/any field-operator-value conditions, round-trips stored expressions and evaluates in the runtime engine (conditionModel.test.ts).

Condition builder renders entity pickers for kinded fields, boolean/enum selects, opens Add condition with the field picker, and falls back to Expression mode (WorkflowConditionBuilder.test.tsx, workflowConditionFields.test.ts).
tickets.find returns related-record names, latest_comment and latest_customer_comment, and nulls when records or comments are missing (ticketWorkflowBoardStatusRuntime.test.ts; mocked query builder).
Step insertion targeting and unique default output names (workflowStepTree.test.ts, workflowSaveAsNames.test.ts, insertionText.test.ts).

Palette and event search ranking, synonyms scoped to name and code, nested action listing and no-match state (paletteSearch.test.ts, searchSynonyms.test.ts, workflowTriggerEventOptions.test.ts, WorkflowDesignerPalette.test.tsx, SearchableSelect.ranking/keywords tests).
Trigger lookup hints list carried fields, offer the pre-wired lookup step and event tips (WorkflowEntityLookupHint.test.tsx, workflowEntityLookupSuggestions.test.ts).

Single Value from control and shared grouped field picker: options, ranking, pick writes reference/fixed/text/expression (workflowFieldPicker.test.tsx, referenceSourceModel.test.ts, InputMappingEditorReferenceMode/UnifiedEditor tests).

Text templates compile to and parse from joined expressions; preview uses sample data and the first loop item; caret intent appends at end unless placed (textTemplate.test.ts, InputMappingEditorUnifiedEditor.test.tsx).
One-item list wrapping for single-value references into list inputs and its reopen note (referenceValue.test.ts).

Expression function catalog: every catalog function is accepted by the runtime validator and designer diagnostics; truncate/substring bounds and errors; syntax help renders the catalog (expressionEngine.test.ts, diagnosticsProvider.test.ts, ExpressionSyntaxHelp.test.tsx, authoringGuide.test.ts).
Expression type inference: concatenation is text, comparisons boolean, list literals arrays (expressionTypeInference.test.ts).
Suggestion quality: whole-word matching, type/kind/role rules, actor fields excluded, free-text excluded; bulk apply limited to required exact matches (autoMappingSuggestions.test.ts).

Default values and required counts: structured sub-fields only when set, boolean/number defaults, explicit-choice visibility, card and panel counts agree (inputDefaultsAndRequired.test.tsx, actionInputEditorState.test.ts, InputMappingEditorStructuredLiterals.test.tsx).

Schema metadata coverage: every entity id in event and date-trigger payloads has a picker kind; ticket, notification and email action editor metadata; settings schema metadata (entityIdMetadata.test.ts, register*Metadata tests, workflow-runtime-v2-schemas.metadata.test.ts).

Assignment picker commits a selection under parent re-renders (regression), and the flat assignment editor maps to the runtime shape (WorkflowTicketAssignmentEditor.picker.test.tsx, WorkflowTicketAssignmentEditor.test.ts, InputMappingEditorPickerFields.test.tsx).

Recipient editors: in-app users/roles and email address chips; custom literal editor dispatcher falls back for computed values (WorkflowRecipientEditors.test.tsx, workflowCustomLiteralEditor.test.tsx).
Shared UI: CustomSelect first-click commit, SearchableSelect groups and ranking, multi-user picker search (CustomSelect.test.tsx, SearchableSelect.*.test.tsx, MultiUserAndTeamPicker.search.test.tsx).

Route-keyed loading: Back after first save and bfcache restore show the saved workflow; replaceEditorAddress keeps Next's router in sync (WorkflowDesignerRouteLoading.test.tsx, workflowEditorRoute.test.ts).

Header lifecycle: save status states, publish confirmation, Active/Paused switch with rollback, settings with empty concurrency limit and plain errors, session-expired dialog (WorkflowSaveStatus.test.tsx, WorkflowDesignerPublishErrorReset.test.tsx, workflowDesignerShellHelpers.test.ts, WorkflowDesigner.smoke.test.tsx).

Run dialog payload issues: browser and server produce the same plain-language per-field issues; inline rendering and Generate test id (payloadIssues.test.ts, workflowRunPayloadIssues.test.ts, WorkflowRunDialogPayloadIssues.test.tsx).

Run dialog record fill replaces untouched samples and keeps author edits; ticket reply, contract and asset resolvers (workflowRunRecordFill.test.ts, workflowRunRecordResolvers.test.ts, WorkflowContractPicker.test.tsx, WorkflowTicketPicker.test.tsx, workflowTicketPickerSearch.test.ts).

Date-trigger occurrence rule shared by scheduler and dialog (sign convention, all four sources) and per-workflow draft payloads (dateTriggerOccurrence.test.ts, workflowRunDateTriggerAndDrafts.test.ts, WorkflowRunDialogDateTrigger.test.tsx).

Run start feedback and initial payload: success/failure messaging, run links, blank Form Builder defaults, launcher returns run id and reason (workflowRunStartFeedback.test.ts, workflowRunDialogInitialPayload.test.ts, workflowRunDialogFormFields.test.ts, workflowRunLauncher.test.ts).

Run Studio labels, graph layout and run-source presentation, engine-unreachable explanation (runStudioStepLabels.test.ts, buildWorkflowGraph.test.ts, RunStudioShell.test.tsx, workflowRunDisplayError.test.ts, workflowRunTriggerPresentation.unit.test.ts).
Workflow list row menu and Unpublished changes badge; audit user names (WorkflowList.test.tsx, WorkflowDesignerAuditPanel.test.tsx, workflow-audit-csv.test.ts).
Friendly field labels and trigger-aware wording (workflowFieldNamesAndWording.test.ts, workflowReferenceOptions.test.ts).

Playwright journeys updated for the publish confirmation and Value from control (workflow-designer-publish, workflow-designer-e2e, workflow-ticket-created-add-comment). Updated, not run in this environment.
